desc:
⚔️ Command your own army in a 4-way war for the banners! ⚔️

🛡️ Raise up to 25 soldiers and give the orders: Follow, Testudo, Missiles, Charge, Hold
🚩 Take flags and storm enemy bases. First to 3000 points, or the last camp standing, wins
🐺 Pick your commander: Wolf, Bear, Lion or Elephant, each with an animal tactical on Q
🏹 Fight in the front line yourself with your sword, shield and javelins
🏛️ Meet other commanders in the Forum before battle

📱💻🎮 Play on PC, phone, tablet and controller

🖥️ PC CONTROLS (rebind any key in Menu, P)
LMB / F: attack
RMB: shield
Q: tactical
E: orders
G: javelin
R: horn
T: signs
Shift: sprint
Z / X: hire militia / defender
Tab: shop

⭐ Like and favorite for new commanders and updates!
